provider: ADTAQ Storage VPS — 2 TB, 30 days free (card-gated)

free_tier.stated: 2 TB HDD, 2 vCPU, 2 GB RAM, 2 TB/month transfer on a 1 Gbps port, USD 20/month; paid ladder USD 10/TB up to 8 TB; the current page offers a 30-day money-back guarantee on the first order.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: unverified: the first-party storage-vps page lists a 2 TB disk per server but publishes no per-object cap.

retention.notes: unverified: the first-party page states a 30-day money-back guarantee; no file retention period is published.

egress.terms: 2 TB/month transfer is included with the 2 TB plan on a 1 Gbps port; beyond the allowance the port slows down rather than billed, and extra transfer is available at USD 1.50/TB.

tooling: Root KVM VPS: full SSH/SFTP/rsync, mountable as rclone sftp remote or with rclone mount + fuse. Host rep explicitly runs KVM + VirtFusion.
chaining: The one-month free trial is a soft launch limited to 24 users and requires a card given to Stripe; larger plans are excluded.
limits_note: 30-day trial then $20/mo unless cancelled. 6 TB/month egress cap. 2 TB per server; larger trial sizes explicitly refused ('we are not offering free trials for those at this time (nor do we plan to)').

identity_cost.detail: a credit card given to Stripe at trial signup

reliability_note: Small Idaho host (Lincoln Freedom Group LLC), Boise datacentre, RAID6. New enough that the soft launch itself was the reliability test; no long-run track record. Trial VPS is deleted if not converted.
